description: This file defines a client for interacting with the Spoonacular API, including methods for searching recipes, retrieving detailed information and nutrition data, and generating meal plans. It also includes custom exception handling and configuration setup.

classes.name: SpoonacularError
classes.description: Custom exception raised when the Spoonacular API returns an error response.

classes.name: _Timeouts
classes.description: Internal model to store timeout settings for the HTTP client.

classes.name: SpoonacularClient
classes.description: Asynchronous client class for interacting with the Spoonacular API, including methods for searching recipes, getting recipe details, and generating meal plans.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _get(self, path: str, params: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None)
methods.description: Internal method to perform GET requests to the Spoonacular API with error handling.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] search_recipes(self, query: str, number: int = 10, diet: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Searches for recipes based on a query string, with optional diet filter.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_recipe_information(self, recipe_id: int, include_nutrition: bool = False)
methods.description: Fetches detailed information for a specific recipe by ID, with optional nutrition info.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_recipe_nutrition(self, recipe_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches nutrition widget data for a specific recipe.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] generate_meal_plan(self, time_frame: str = "day", target_calories: Optional[int] = None, diet: Optional[str] = None, exclude: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Generates a meal plan for a specified time frame, with optional target calories, diet, and exclusions.
